title: A Hopf algebra on nonplanar binary forests
summary: We equip the graded polynomial algebra generated by nonplanar rooted binary trees with a Hopf algebra structure by defining a coproduct which disallows cutting both children of any given vertex, refining Connes-Kreimer's notion of admissible cuts. We show that the terms in this coproduct have an additional combinatorial interpretation in terms of subsets of leaves, which facilitates the construction of Hopf algebra morphisms involving this Hopf algebra, and creates a connection with a Hopf algebra of Bruned used in the renormalization of stochastic processes.
